**Summary:**  
This version standardizes user identity handling and cloud report querying, removing the need for manual open-id input.

- User identity (open-id) is now handled automatically and transparently by the system; users are no longer asked to enter or provide personal identifiers.
- Cloud querying of historical fall detection reports is enforced, with all local/manual data aggregation methods disabled.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) rewritten for clarity, reflecting internalized identity handling and revised workflow.
- Removed now-obsolete documentation and scripts related to manual API service handling.
- Dependency and resource references updated for streamlined usage.

- Updated license information to "MIT-0" in SKILL.md.
- Adjusted config.yaml path logic and open-id resolution sequence in documentation for clarity.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- Various internal scripts updated for configuration and requirements consistency.

- Major codebase refactor to introduce the new "smyx_analysis" module for analysis functionality.
- Removed legacy "face_analysis" module and related scripts.
- Updated and reorganized configuration files for improved modularity.
- Enhanced dependencies management, separating requirements for core and analysis features.
- Documentation and references updated to reflect new module structure and usage.

- Improved shared configuration handling across multiple skills in the smyx_common module.
- Unified and simplified config file management for development, testing, and production environments.
- Updated internal utility scripts for better reliability and maintainability.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or core fall detection features.

- Initial release of "elderly-fall-detection-analysis" skill.
- Enables contactless fall detection for seniors using vision and radar technology, with second-level alarm triggering.
- Strict privacy: no wearable devices required; no local memory read; all history queries must go through cloud API.
- Provides structured detection reports, automatic monitoring, and emergency recommendations for home safety.
- Enforces secure open-id acquisition before any report access or analysis.
- Supports image/video input, historical report queries via cloud, and detailed Markdown report table output.
